correctness.rationale: For odd n the CRT reindexing of all 2n vertices maps each open-prism three-neighbor constraint to a distinct closed triple on C_2n, with exact weight preservation. For even n two independent length-n words satisfy ordinary cycle closed-neighborhood conditions, so generating polynomials multiply. The gap-count formula is exactly counted by m(k-1)!/(a!b!c!). An exact 16-state Newton determinant plus direct exhaustive 1,398,080-mask check for n=3..10 independently supports all coefficients; the all-order proof does not depend on finite tests.

value.rationale: The parity-twisted open-to-closed-neighborhood classification is structurally motivated for the family of cubic cycle prisms and completely determines every cardinality coefficient, beyond prior scalars T_n(1) and minimal-set counts. It also gives the full independent-site total-domination reliability polynomial for arbitrary occupancy probability. The odd branch provides a nontrivial single doubled-cycle reduction, whereas the even splitting is credited to generic bipartite-prism work.
